description: Three actual bootstrapped nodes elect node 1. Commit an implicit joint change removing 3. Start transfer to 2 during the Ready carrying that committed change, before application completion; drop only actual TimeoutNow until abort. Drain all work, restore reliable delivery, and compare serialized protocol/storage state across a full ten-tick schedule period. The period is a recurrence witness, not an imposed exit deadline. A subsequent proposal is diagnostic only.

harness.description: Single-threaded deterministic driver with actual RawNode APIs, MemoryStorage and actual routed protocol messages; test-local read-only structural capture.
semantic_changes: No target code or dependencies changed.
In-memory successful storage models crash-free completed persistence.
Transient network loss is limited to actual MsgTimeoutNow messages during transfer.
Fresh post-observation proposal is a diagnostic alternative trigger.

legality.derivation: Three RawNodes Bootstrap actual peer entries and persist/apply all Ready work. Actual election and proposal traffic establish the prefix. During leader Ready application of the committed implicit removal of voter 3, TransferLeader(2) is invoked before ApplyConfChange and Advance; Node also permits message processing while an Advance is outstanding. Actual TimeoutNow messages are dropped until the transfer timeout; all other messages use one FIFO queue. After abort all traffic is delivered. The driver handles documented ErrStepPeerNotFound as rejected stale peer response and records it; no protocol behavior is modified. After each tick every Ready and queued message is drained. Reflection observes serialized RawNode state, including term/role/timers/dispatch/progress/queues/unstable/application bookkeeping and backing contents, with storage separately captured. Only logger, traceLogger and the duplicate Storage interface reference are excluded; no crashes, new callbacks or elections occur in the compared suffix. Diagnostic proposal follows the completed comparison and is not part of the required continuation.
legality.applicability: Crash-free synchronous RawNode integration; one admitted implicit joint change, transient dropped transfer TimeoutNow, no remaining transfer and reliable transport thereafter. No obligation for new client proposals or a new election is added.
alternatives: A later applied client entry or new-leader entry can provide another trigger, but neither is owed by the caller in the otherwise quiescent scenario.
unresolved: Review must verify that the equal-state projection and repeated fixed schedule close the relevant transition system; a bounded noncompletion observation alone is insufficient.

grounding.derivation: ConfChangeTransitionJointImplicit and ConfState.AutoLeave assign automatic exit to Raft when safe. AppliedTo implements this by proposing a zero configuration change. Transfer temporarily rejects proposals; timeout ends that block. With committed configuration fully applied, stable leader, available joint quorum and fair execution of required ticks, messages and Ready completion, an exactly repeatable no-progress state cycle retaining AutoLeave contradicts implementation-owned automatic continuation. No numeric exit deadline is inferred.

observable_properties.description: For the admitted implicit joint operation, an exactly repeated fair post-abort protocol/storage state implies there is no still-pending automatic joint exit. cycle_equal=false is only vacuous local holds, not successful eventual exit. Equal before/after state with AutoLeave=true supplies the finite recurrence witness, contingent on semantic review of captured state and schedule.
